summary: Verified the stale-job sweep in _maybe_trigger_auto_plan_adjust (routers/sessions.py). Created a new pytest that (a) inserts a stale (10 min old) pending job for the admin, monkeypatches asyncio.create_task, and calls the function in-process — asserts stale job is marked 'error' with 'Server-Neustart' message and a NEW pending job is spawned; (b) verifies that a <5min-old pending job is untouched (idempotency preserved). All 23 tests pass (2 new + 21 regression from prior iterations).
critical_code_review_comments: The sweep block in sessions.py lines 341-357 is a near-verbatim copy of the block in coach.py lines 137-153. Consider extracting into a small helper like `_sweep_stale_pending_plan_adjust_job(user_id) -> bool` to remove duplication (DRY).
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown — non-blocking but should migrate to lifespan handlers.
seed_data_creation: Test inserts TEST_-prefixed workout_sessions and plan_adjust_jobs; teardown removes/marks them so no lingering state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Async tests must use pytest_asyncio.fixture(loop_scope='session') AND @pytest.mark.asyncio(loop_scope='session') due to server.py's module-level motor client. Also, tests using in-process DB calls should create their own AsyncIOMotorClient bound to the current loop (see admin_user fixture) — otherwise 'Event loop is closed' errors surface when combined with sync HTTP tests.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bug found; the ported sweep logic behaves identically to the coach.py reference.
